surface: Complete @xstate/react 6.1 runtime surface: useActor, useActorRef, deprecated useMachine, useSelector, createActorContext, and shallowEqual. The framework-independent xstate 5.32.5 actor runtime is reused unchanged.
ssr: Supported: machine and actor-context hooks render their initial snapshots on the server; actors start after client mount.
notes: Differential coverage runs useMachine and createActorContext through this adapter and real @xstate/react, comparing rendered output after the same events.
Conformance coverage additionally checks external actor selectors, comparator bailouts, actor-ref identity and cleanup, missing-provider errors, export parity, and required actor-input types.
